1041: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ; ਭਵਜਲੁ. ਜਾਇ. ਨ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Without Truth the terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed;
ਏਹੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ; ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
this ocean is unfathomable, filled with deadly poison.
ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ. ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਊਪਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
One who takes the Guru's teaching remains detached above it, and finds the Lord in the home of the Fearless. ॥6॥
False is the cleverness of love for the world;
it takes no time at all to come and go.
ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ, ਚਲਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ; ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
The proud depart having forgotten the Name; they are born and perish, and waste away. ॥7॥
They are born and perish, bound in bonds,
with the nooses of ego and Maya around their necks.
ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ; ਸੋ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
One who has not the Lord's Name through the Guru's teaching is bound and driven to the city of Death. ॥8॥
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Without the Guru, how can one obtain liberation?
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Without the Guru, how can one meditate on the Lord's Name?
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ. ਤਰਹੁ ਭਵ ਦੁਤਰੁ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Take the Guru's teaching and cross the impassable world-ocean; liberated, one finds peace. ॥9॥
Through the Guru's teaching Krishna lifted Mount Govardhan;
through the Guru's teaching stones were floated on the ocean.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ. ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ. ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Take the Guru's teaching and attain the supreme state; Nanak, the Guru has dispelled doubt. ॥10॥
Take the Guru's teaching and cross over by the true float;
examine your own soul and keep the Lord in your heart.
ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ. ਕਾਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ; ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Meditating on the Lord, Death's nooses are cut, and one finds the Immaculate One, beyond lineage. ॥11॥
Through the Guru's teaching the five virtues become one's companions and brothers in the Guru;
the Guru's teaching quenches the fire and merges one in the Name.
ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
With mind and mouth chant the Name of the Life of the world; within the heart the Unseen is revealed. ॥12॥
One who understands through the Guru is satisfied by the Word;
whom then should one praise or slander?
ਚੀਨਹੁ ਆਪੁ. ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੁ; ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Know yourself and meditate on the Lord of the world; the Lord, Master of the universe, is pleasing to the mind. ॥13॥
Know that He who is in the universe is in the body as well;
understand through the Guru, and recognise Him through the Word.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ; ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
The Enjoyer enjoys in every heart, yet remains detached from all. ॥14॥
Through the Guru's teaching speak the Lord's pure praise;
through the Guru's teaching behold the Lofty One with your eyes.
ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੨੦॥
One whose ears hear the Name and the Lord's Word, Nanak, is dyed in the Lord's love. ॥15॥3॥20॥
Give up lust, anger and slander of others;
abandon greed and avarice, and be free of worry.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਤੋੜਿ. ਨਿਰਾਲਾ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Breaking the chain of doubt, one is unattached, and finds the Lord and His essence within. ॥1॥
ਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਚਮਕਿ; ਚੰਦਾਇਣੁ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
As a lightning flash at night reveals the light,
so day and night one beholds the Light everywhere.
ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਸਰੂਪਾ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
The Perfect Guru has shown the One of incomparable beauty, the embodiment of bliss. ॥2॥
Meet the True Guru, and God Himself will carry you across;
the sun shines in the home of the moon, a lamp in the sky of the heart.
ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Beholding the Unseen, remain lovingly attuned; God pervades all the three worlds. ॥3॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਉ ਜਾਏ ॥
One who obtains the ambrosial essence is rid of craving and fear;
casting off self-conceit, one attains the state of enlightenment.
ਊਚੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
One attains the highest of the high states, having lived the immaculate Word. ॥4॥
The Name of the Invisible, Imperceptible, Infinite One
1042: is supremely sweet in taste and beloved.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ. ਅੰਤੁ, ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Grant Nanak the Lord's praise age after age; chanting the Lord, His end is not found. ॥5॥
One who obtains the diamond of the Name within,
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤੇ; ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ. ਧੀਰਾ ॥
chanting the Lord, the mind is steadied from within.
ਦੁਘਟ ਘਟ. ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ. ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
One finds the Destroyer of fear on the treacherous path, and is not born again. ॥6॥
Through the Guru's Word there are waves of love for devotion;
I beg for the Lord's praise and the treasure of the Name.
ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
When it pleases the Lord, He unites one with the Guru; the Lord carries the whole world across. ॥7॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਓ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਵਾ ਕੇ ॥
One who has chanted His chant has the True Guru's teaching within;
ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਾਲੁ; ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
Death and its messengers become servants at his feet.
ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਊਤਮ; ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Sublime is his company, sublime his state and way; he carries the world across the terrifying ocean. ॥8॥
ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
This terrifying world-ocean is crossed through the Guru's Word;
the duality within is burnt away within.
ਪੰਚ ਬਾਣ ਲੇ. ਜਮ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ; ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Drawing the bow in the sky of the mind, with the five arrows he kills Death. ॥9॥
ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰਿ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ. ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
How can the faithless man attain awareness of the Word?
Without awareness of the Word one comes and goes.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣੁ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Nanak, through the Guru is the support of liberation; by perfect destiny the Lord unites one with him. ॥10॥
The fearless True Guru is the protector;
through the Guru, devotion to the Lord of the world is obtained.
ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
The blissful unstruck melody resounds; through the Guru's Word one finds the Immaculate One. ॥11॥
He is fearless; there is no account over His head;
He Himself is unaccountable, and is seen in His creation.
ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
He Himself is detached, unborn and self-existent; Nanak, He is found through the Guru's teaching. ॥12॥
One who knows the True Guru knows the inner state,
and recognises the Fearless One through the Guru's Word.
ਅੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ. ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ; ਅਨਤ. ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Examining the self within, he understands Him to be everywhere, and the mind does not waver elsewhere. ॥13॥
The Fearless One dwells deep within the heart
of one who savours the Immaculate Name day and night.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Nanak, the Lord's praise is obtained in the congregation; the Lord unites one with Himself in perfect poise. ॥14॥
One who knows God within and without
remains detached and brings the wandering mind back home.
ਊਪਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਰਬ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੪॥੨੧॥
Above all, the Primal One of the three worlds — Nanak has found the True One, the ambrosial essence. ॥15॥4॥21॥
The Creator of nature is infinite;
what He has made has no power before Him.
ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੇ ਆਪੇ; ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
He creates beings and Himself gives them sustenance; He runs His command over each and every one. ॥1॥
Running His command, He pervades all;
to whom is He near, and from whom can I say He is far?
ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ; ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
See the Lord hidden and manifest in every heart; the One Himself pervades all. ॥2॥
One whom He unites is absorbed in awareness
and meditates on the Lord's Name through the Guru's Word.
ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਗੋਚਰ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਭਰਮੁ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
The embodiment of bliss, incomparable, imperceptible — meeting the Guru, doubt departs. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
One to whom the Name is dearer than mind, body and wealth
has the Lord as companion at the end, departing with him.
1043: ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੇਲੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ. ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
The expanse of attachment is no friend or companion; without the Lord and the Guru, who has found peace? ॥4॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
One on whom the Perfect Guru casts his glance
he unites with the Word, and through the Guru's teaching he becomes brave.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Nanak, serve the feet of the Guru, who sets the strayed on the path. ॥5॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ; ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
To the saints the wealth of the Lord and His praise are dear;
through the Guru's teaching they have obtained Your Name.
ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
The beggar serves at the Lord's door and sings His praises in His court. ॥6॥
When one meets the True Guru, the Lord calls one into His mansion;
in the true court one obtains salvation and honour.
ਸਾਕਤ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ. ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
The faithless find no place in the Lord's temple; born and dying, they suffer pain. ॥7॥
Serve the True Guru, the unfathomable ocean,
and obtain the jewel and wealth of the Name, the profit.
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸਰ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
The filth of poison is washed away; bathe in the pool of nectar, and from the Guru's pool obtain contentment. ॥8॥
Serve the True Guru without doubt;
amid hopes remain free of hope.
ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Serve the Destroyer of anxiety and pain, and disease will not afflict you again. ॥9॥
Whoever is pleasing to the True One, He exalts;
who else can instruct such a one?
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
The Lord and the Guru are of one form; Nanak, the Lord is pleasing to the Guru. ॥10॥
They read books, the Vedas and Puranas;
some sit and listen, and recite to others' ears.
ਅਜਗਰ ਕਪਟੁ. ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਖੁਲੑੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਤਤੁ, ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Tell me, how can the rigid door of deceit open? Without the True Guru the essence is not found. ॥11॥
They make ashes and smear their bodies with them,
yet within them is the outcaste of anger, and ego.
ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕੀਨੇ. ਜੋਗੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਅਲਖੁ, ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
By hypocrisy union is not attained; without the True Guru the Unseen is not found. ॥12॥
They keep pilgrimages, fasts and vows, and dwell in the wilderness;
they practise celibacy, truth and self-discipline and speak of wisdom.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਭਰਮੁ, ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Without the Lord's Name how can one find peace? Without the True Guru doubt does not depart. ॥13॥
They perform the inner-cleansing practices and raise the coiled serpent power,
inhale, hold and exhale the breath with stubborn mind;
ਪਾਖੰਡ. ਧਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
this is hypocritical religion, with no love for the Lord; the supreme essence is found through the Guru's Word. ॥14॥
Those who behold Him in creation are reconciled in mind;
through the Guru's Word they recognise God in all.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੫॥੨੨॥
Nanak, the all-pervading Lord is in all; the Guru, the True Guru, reveals the Unseen. ॥15॥5॥22॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
By His command He created the universe with ease;
creating, He beholds His own glory.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
He Himself acts and causes to act; by His command He pervades all. ॥1॥
Attachment to Maya makes the world pitch dark;
rare is the Guru-facing one who understands this.
ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
One on whom He Himself casts His glance obtains it; He Himself unites in His union. ॥2॥
1044: He Himself unites and grants glory;
by the Guru's grace one realises the worth.
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
The self-willed world wanders about wailing, ruined by the love of duality. ॥3॥
He placed ego and Maya within it;
the self-willed have strayed and lost their honour.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਰਾਚੈ; ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
One who turns to the Guru is absorbed in the Name, and remains merged in the True One. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
From the Guru one obtains wisdom and the jewel of the Name,
and subduing desire, merges within the mind.
ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
The Creator Himself stages all the plays; He Himself gives understanding. ॥5॥
One who serves the True Guru and casts off self-conceit,
meets the Beloved and finds peace through the Word.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ. ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸਹਜਿ ਮਤੇ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
With love within, one is imbued with devotion; through the intuitive mind one is bonded with Him. ॥6॥
One who knows the Remover of pain through the Guru
is met by the Giver, the Life of the world, Himself.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Only one whom He attaches understands; fear and doubt leave the body. ॥7॥
He Himself makes one Guru-facing and He Himself gives;
through the true Word one serves the True Guru.
ਜਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Old age and Death cannot touch one whose bond is with the True One. ॥8॥
The world is burning in the fire of craving;
burning and burning, it wastes away in great vice.
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕਬਹੂ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
The self-willed never find a place of rest; the True Guru gives understanding. ॥9॥
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate;
they remain ever lovingly attuned to the True Name.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The pure Name pervades within them, and through the Word they quench their craving. ॥10॥
True is the Word, true the Guru's Word;
rare is the Guru-facing one who recognises it.
ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Imbued with the true Word, they are detached, and their coming and going is ended. ॥11॥
One who understands the Word washes away the filth,
and the immaculate Name comes to dwell in the mind.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Those who ever serve their True Guru are rid of ego within. ॥12॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ; ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
When one understands through the Guru, one sees the Lord's door;
one without the Name babbles and quarrels, burning within.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
The glory of serving the True Guru is that craving and hunger are removed. ॥13॥
When He Himself meets one, then one understands;
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ. ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
The Guru's gift is ever in the mind; through the Word His praise resounds within. ॥14॥
ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
One does the deeds written from the start;
no one can erase the Primal command.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ; ਜਿਨ ਕਉ. ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
They alone dwell in the true congregation who have such destiny written from the start. ॥15॥
One on whom He casts His glance obtains it,
and fixes the mind in trance on the true Word.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
Servant Nanak prays: one receives the alms of the Name at His door. ॥16॥1॥
rare is the Guru-facing one who understands
ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ, ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
that the One pervades within all; there is no other but Him. ॥1॥
He created the beings of the 8.4 million species;
1045: the wise and the meditative have said so.
ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਆਪੇ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
He Himself provides sustenance to all; no other has such worth. ॥2॥
Attachment to Maya is blinding darkness;
the expanse of ego and possessiveness is spread out.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Night and day the world keeps burning; without the Guru there is no peace. ॥3॥
He Himself joins and He Himself separates;
He Himself establishes and He Himself disestablishes.
ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਸਚਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ; ਹੋਰਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
True is His command, true His expanse; no other has command. ॥4॥
One whom He Himself attaches is attached;
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
by the Guru's grace the fear of Death flees.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Within is the Word, ever the giver of peace; rare is the Guru-facing one who understands. ॥5॥
He Himself unites and joins in union;
ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੋ ਮੇਟਣਾ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
what is written by past deeds cannot be erased.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Night and day one worships Him day and night; through the Guru service is done. ॥6॥
Serving the True Guru one knows lasting peace;
ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
the Giver of all Himself comes to meet one.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ; ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Subduing ego, one quenches the fire of craving; realising the Word, there is peace. ॥7॥
One attached to body and family does not understand;
if one turns to the Guru, one sees with one's own eyes.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Night and day one dwells on the Name, day and night; meeting the Beloved there is peace. ॥8॥
The self-willed one is attached to Maya and duality;
why did the unfortunate one not die at birth?
ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Coming and going, he wastes his life in vain; without the Guru there is no liberation. ॥9॥
The body is impure, stained with the filth of ego;
ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਹਿ; ਤਾ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
though one washes it a hundred times, the filth does not go.
ਸਬਦਿ ਧੋਪੈ. ਤਾ ਹਛੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
When it is washed with the Word it becomes clean, and is never soiled again. ॥10॥
The five demons destroy the body;
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ; ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
those who do not reflect on the Word die and are born again.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ; ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਧਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Within them is the darkness of attachment to Maya; as in a dream, they have no awareness. ॥11॥
ਇਕਿ ਪੰਚਾ ਮਾਰਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਹੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Some subdue the five and attach themselves to the Word;
by great fortune the True Guru has come to meet them.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Within, they dwell on the True One, imbued with His love; such a one merges in poise. ॥12॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ; ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
The Guru's way is known from the Guru;
the perfect servant is recognised through the Word.
ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ. ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
He ever dwells on the Word within the heart; his tongue tastes the essence — that one is true. ॥13॥
He subdues ego and removes it through the Word,
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ. ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
and keeps the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart.
ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਹਉ ਹੋਰੁ, ਨ ਜਾਣਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
I know no other but the One; whatever happens by His will comes to pass. ॥14॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਸਹਜੁ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Without the True Guru no one has found poise;
the Guru-facing understand and merge in the True One.
ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚ ਰਾਤੇ; ਹਉਮੈ. ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Serving the True One, imbued with the true Word, they have cast off ego through the Word. ॥15॥
He Himself is the Giver of virtue, the Contemplator;
to the Guru-facing You give the winning dice.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
Nanak, they merge in the True Name; from the True One comes honour. ॥16॥2॥
The True One, Life of the world, is the one Giver;
through serving the Guru He is recognised through the Word.
1046: ਏਕੋ ਅਮਰੁ. ਏਕਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
His alone is the command, His alone the sovereignty; age after age He assigns each one's task. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
That person is pure who has recognised himself;
the Giver of peace Himself comes to meet him.
ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
His tongue, imbued with the Word, sings His praises; at the true door he obtains honour. ॥2॥
Through the Guru one obtains glory in the Name;
the self-willed slanderer loses his honour.
ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Imbued with the Name, the supreme swans are detached, absorbed in trance in their own home. ॥3॥
One who dies through the Word is perfect;
the heroic True Guru has proclaimed this.
ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Within the body is the true pool of nectar; the mind drinks of it with love. ॥4॥
The pandit reads and instructs others,
ਘਰ ਜਲਤੇ ਕੀ; ਖਬਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
but does not know that his own house is on fire.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਨਾਮੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Without serving the True Guru the Name is not found; they grow weary of reading and find no peace. ॥5॥
Some smear ashes and wander in religious garbs;
without the Word, who has conquered ego?
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਭਰਮਿ ਭੇਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Night and day they keep burning, led astray by doubt and garbs. ॥6॥
ਇਕਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ; ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Some, amid household and family, remain ever detached;
dying through the Word, they dwell in the Lord's Name.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Night and day they remain imbued with His love; in fear and love they fix their minds on devotion. ॥7॥
The self-willed is ruined slandering again and again;
greed within him barks like a dog.
ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Death never leaves him; in the end he departs repenting. ॥8॥
Through the true Word comes true honour;
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
without the Name no one obtains liberation.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਕੋ ਨਾਉ, ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Without the True Guru no one obtains the Name; God has made it so. ॥9॥
Some are Siddhas, seekers and great contemplatives;
some are imbued day and night with the Name of the Formless One.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
One whom He Himself unites understands; through loving devotion fear departs. ॥10॥
People bathe and give in charity, but do not understand;
ਇਕਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ; ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ॥
some subdue the mind and wrestle with the mind.
ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Imbued with the true Word, they are dyed in the One's love; through the true Word they are united. ॥11॥
He Himself creates and grants glory;
by His own will He unites.
ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਇਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
He Himself casts His glance and dwells in the mind; my God has so commanded. ॥12॥
Those who serve the True Guru are true;
the shallow self-willed do not know how to serve.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
The Creator Himself creates and beholds; as it pleases Him, so He engages people. ॥13॥
Age after age the True One is the one Giver;
by perfect destiny one recognises the Guru's Word.
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ. ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਹੀ; ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Those united through the Word are not separated; by His glance they are united in poise. ॥14॥
Through ego and Maya people gather filth;
they die and are born again, loving duality.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ; ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Without serving the True Guru there is no liberation; reflect attentively in your mind and see. ॥15॥
1047: Whatever pleases Him, that He will do;
nothing has happened or will happen by one's own doing.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
Nanak, through the Name comes glory; at the true door one obtains honour. ॥16॥3॥
ਜੋ ਆਇਆ; ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
in the love of duality one is bound in Death's noose.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Those whom the True Guru protects are saved, merging in the Truest of the true. ॥1॥
The Creator Himself creates and beholds;
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
that one is approved on whom He casts His glance.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ; ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru comes wisdom, and he understands everything; the ignorant act blindly. ॥2॥
The self-willed are anxious and have no understanding;
they die and are born again, wasting life.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
The Guru-facing, imbued with the Name, find peace and merge in poise in the True One. ॥3॥
Running after worldly affairs, the mind has become slag;
ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ; ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
it becomes gold again on meeting the Perfect Guru.
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
One whom He Himself forgives finds peace, united through the perfect Word. ॥4॥
Evil-minded, false, wicked of the wicked,
ਕਚੀ ਮਤਿ. ਫੀਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ. ਨਾਮੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
of shallow mind she speaks harshly; through evil-mindedness she does not obtain the Name. ॥5॥
The bride full of faults is not pleasing to her Husband;
impure of mind, she does impure deeds.
ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਉ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂਰਖਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
The fool does not know her Husband's delight; without the Guru she has no understanding. ॥6॥
The evil-minded, counterfeit one practises counterfeit;
ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ; ਪਿਰ ਖਸਮ. ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
she adorns herself, but is not pleasing to her Husband, her Master.
ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
The virtuous bride ever enjoys her Husband; the True Guru unites her in union. ॥7॥
He Himself issues the command and watches all;
some He forgives by His Primal decree.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Imbued with the Name night and day, they obtain the True One; He Himself unites them. ॥8॥
Maya attaches one to ego and the taste of attachment;
the Guru-facing, with true love, merge in poise.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਬੂਝ, ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
He Himself unites and Himself beholds; without the True Guru there is no understanding. ॥9॥
ਇਕਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Some reflect on the Word and remain ever awake;
ਇਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ; ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
some, unfortunate, remain asleep in attachment to Maya.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ. ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ; ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
He Himself acts and causes to act; nothing else can be done. ॥10॥
Killing death through the Guru's Word, one removes ego,
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
and keeps the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Through serving the True Guru one finds peace and merges in the Lord's Name. ॥11॥
In the love of duality she wanders crazed;
through attachment to Maya she is absorbed in pain.
ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ. ਨਹ ਪਾਏ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
She wears many religious garbs but does not find Him; without the True Guru there is no peace. ॥12॥
ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
To whom can one complain, when He Himself causes all?
He makes one walk the path that pleases Him.
ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
He Himself is the merciful Giver of peace; as it pleases Him, so He leads. ॥13॥
He Himself is the Creator, He Himself the enjoyer;
He Himself is self-restraint, He Himself pervades all.
ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ; ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
He Himself is pure, merciful, Slayer of demons, whose command cannot be erased. ॥14॥
Very fortunate are those who know the One,
1048: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
the Giver, Life of the world, dwelling in every heart.
ਇਕ ਥੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ. ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
In one place He is hidden, in another manifest; through the Guru doubt and fear depart. ॥15॥
Through the Guru one knows the One Lord;
with the Name within, one recognises Him through the Word.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ. ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
Only one to whom You give it receives it; Nanak, in the Name is glory. ॥16॥4॥
I praise the True One, deep and profound,
ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
under whose authority is the whole world.
ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
He enjoys all hearts, ever, day and night; He Himself dwells in peace. ॥1॥
True is the Master, true His glory;
by the Guru's grace I enshrine Him in my mind.
ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
He Himself has come to dwell within the heart, and Death's noose is broken. ॥2॥
Whom do I serve, and whom do I praise?
I serve the True Guru and praise Him through the Word.
ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Through the true Word the intellect is ever sublime, and the lotus within blossoms. ॥3॥
The body is flimsy, like paper;
ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਢਹਤ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
a drop of water falls and it perishes, crumbling in no time.
ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The Guru-facing one, in whom the Name dwells, knows the body as gold. ॥4॥
True is the kitchen square whose boundary lines are awareness of Him;
the Lord's Name is the food, Truth the support.
ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਵਨੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Ever satisfied, pure and sanctified is the heart in which the Lord's Name dwells. ॥5॥
ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਜੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those attached to the True One,
who sing the Lord's praises, awake night and day.
ਸਾਚਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
True peace is ever within them; their tongues delight in the Lord's essence. ॥6॥
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
I remember the Lord's Name and worship no other;
I serve the One alone, and no other second.
ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ. ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
The Perfect Guru has shown the True One everywhere; one dwells in the True Name. ॥7॥
ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Wandering and wandering, one comes again and again into births;
one strays oneself only when the Master has led one astray.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ; ਚੀਨੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
When the Lord meets one, then through the Guru one understands and contemplates the Word of the Imperishable. ॥8॥
We sinners are filled with lust and anger;
ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗੁਣ. ਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
with what face can we speak? We have no virtues and have done no service.
ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ. ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ, ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ; ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
We are sinking stones — You Yourself unite us; Your Name is true and imperishable. ॥9॥
ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ; ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
No one does anything, nor is anyone able to do it;
that alone happens which You Yourself do and cause to be done.
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Whom You Yourself forgive finds peace and ever dwells in the Name. ॥10॥
ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ; ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Make this body the soil and sow in it the Word of the Infinite;
trade and deal with the True Lord alone.
ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ. ਤੋਟਿ, ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
The true wealth springs up and never runs short; the Name dwells within. ॥11॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਨੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Dear Lord, grant virtue to this one without virtue;
forgive me Yourself and give me the Name.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ; ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
One who becomes Guru-facing obtains honour and dwells in the One Name alone. ॥12॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ; ਸਮਝ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
The Lord's wealth is within, but there is no understanding of it;
by the Guru's grace some rare one understands.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
One who becomes Guru-facing obtains this wealth and ever dwells in the Name. ॥13॥
Fire and wind (of craving) lead the world astray in doubt;
1049: through attachment to Maya one has no awareness at all.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
The blind self-willed understand nothing; through the Guru's teaching the Name shines forth. ॥14॥
The self-willed sleep in ego and Maya;
ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ. ਨ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ; ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ॥
they do not guard their own home, and are ruined in the end.
ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ. ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੈ; ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
They slander others and are burned by great anxiety; they dwell in pain upon pain. ॥15॥
The Creator Himself has made them do this work;
He Himself grants understanding through the Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
Nanak, imbued with the Name the mind becomes pure; they dwell in the Name alone. ॥16॥5॥
I serve the One alone, eternal and true;
attached to duality, the whole world is flimsy.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Through the Guru's teaching I ever praise the True One; the mind is satisfied in the Truest of the true. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ; ਮੈ ਏਕੁ. ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Your virtues are many; I have not understood even one.
The Giver, Life of the world, Himself attaches one to Himself;
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
He Himself forgives and grants glory; through the Guru's teaching this mind is drenched with love. ॥2॥
One who has stilled the wave of Maya through the Word,
killing ego, this mind becomes pure.
ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
In poise he sings His praises, dyed in His love; his tongue repeats the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
the self-willed, ignorant bride does not understand and wanders about.
ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਰਜਾ ਛੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Death watches every moment and instant; night and day her life wastes away. ॥4॥
She practises greed within and does not understand;
Death hovers over her head, but she does not perceive it.
ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ. ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਇਆ; ਅੰਤਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Whatever is done here must be faced hereafter; what can be done at the last moment? ॥5॥
ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ; ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Those attached to the True One have true renown;
the self-willed, attached to duality, weep.
ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
He Himself is the Master of both ends; He Himself delights in His virtues. ॥6॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word His servant is ever beautified;
this mind is enraptured by the elixir of the Name.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Not a particle of the filth of attachment to Maya touches him; through the Guru's teaching he is drenched in the Lord's Name. ॥7॥
by the Guru's grace He becomes manifest.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਇ ਸਾਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Killing ego, one finds lasting peace; through the True Name the nectar is drunk. ॥8॥
He is the Remover of sins and sorrows;
the Guru-facing serve Him, reflecting on the Word.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
He Himself pervades everything; through the Guru body and mind are drenched with love. ॥9॥
The world is burning in the fire of Maya;
the Guru-facing one quenches it, reflecting on the Word.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Within is calm, and lasting peace is found; through the Guru's teaching the Name is taken. ॥10॥
ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Even Indra, seated on his throne, lives in fear of Death;
ਜਮੁ. ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Death does not spare those who perform many rituals.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ. ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
When one meets the True Guru, liberation is found; with the tongue one drinks the Lord's essence. ॥11॥
Within the self-willed there is no devotion;
through the Guru comes devotion, calm and peace.
ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Ever pure and purifying is the Word; through the Guru's teaching the heart is drenched with love. ॥12॥
Reflect on it: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva
are bound by the three qualities; liberation remains far from them.
1050: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
The Guru-facing have this wisdom: they know the One alone and repeat the Name night and day. ॥13॥
ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ॥
They read the Vedas but do not understand the Lord's Name;
for the sake of Maya they read and read and wrangle.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Filth within, the ignorant are blind; how can the treacherous ocean be crossed? ॥14॥
All recite and expound the debates of the Vedas,
ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ; ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
but their hearts are not drenched, nor do they recognise the Word.
ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
The Vedas impart virtue and vice; through the Guru the nectar is drunk. ॥15॥
He Himself, the One, is True;
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
without Him there is no other at all.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
Nanak, imbued with the Name the mind becomes true; repeat the Truest of the true. ॥16॥6॥
The True One has established the true throne;
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਤਿਥੈ. ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
He dwells in His own home, where there is no attachment to Maya.
ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
The True One ever dwells within the heart of the Guru-facing whose deeds are sublime. ॥1॥
True is the merchandise, true the trade;
ਨ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਰਮੁ; ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
there is no doubt there, nor the expanse of duality.
ਸਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ. ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ, ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
The true wealth earned never runs short; only some reflective one understands. ॥2॥
Those whom the True One attaches are attached;
the Word is within them; the good destiny on their foreheads awakens.
ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Through the true Word they ever sing His praises; imbued with the Word, they become reflective. ॥3॥
I praise the Truest of the true;
I see the One alone, there is no other.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚੀ ਪਉੜੀ; ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The Guru's teaching is the highest of high ladders; with the jewel of wisdom ego is killed. ॥4॥
One who has burnt attachment to Maya through the Word,
ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
the True One dwells in his mind when it pleases You.
ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
All the doings of the True One are true to one who has stilled ego and thirst. ॥5॥
He Himself has made all attachment to Maya;
some rare Guru-facing one has recognised this.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
One who becomes Guru-facing practises Truth; true living is sublime to him. ॥6॥
ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ; ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
One who does the work that pleases my God,
and quenches ego and craving through the Word,
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
through the Guru's teaching his heart is ever cool, having killed and removed ego. ॥7॥
ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ; ਤਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Those attached to the True One are pleased by all He does;
through the true Word they are beautified in the True One.
ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ; ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Those true here are true at His door; the Gracious One adorns them with His glance. ॥8॥
One who, without the True One, is attached to duality
suffers all the pains of attachment to Maya.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਦੁਖੁ, ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Without the Guru one does not know pain from peace; heavy is the pain of attachment to Maya. ॥9॥
Those whose minds are pleased by the true Word
practise what was written by their past deeds.
ਸਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ; ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
They serve the True One, meditate on the True One, and imbued with the True One become reflective. ॥10॥
One to whom service of the Guru is sweet
is night and day in peace and the trance of poise.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਿਆ. ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Repeating the Lord's Name, the mind becomes pure; service of the Guru is dear to him. ॥11॥
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਖੀਏ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Those whom the True Guru attaches to the True One are at peace;
by His own will He Himself unites them.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ; ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Those whom the True Guru protects are saved; others are ruined by attachment to Maya. ॥12॥
